label: Diagram 3
caption: Diagram 3 Separation between hand washbasin/WC and food preparation area – two rooms
description: Diagram 3 is a plan (top view) of two adjoining rooms drawn within an outer rectangular boundary, titled "Separation between hand washbasin/WC and food preparation area – two rooms". A note in the top-left corner reads "See para 4.11". The open area on the left is labelled "Food preparation area". Two rooms lie to its right: a lobby containing a hand washbasin set into its upper wall, and beyond it a room with a water closet (an oval pan with a rectangular cistern against the right-hand wall). Each has a door, drawn open as a diagonal line: one from the food preparation area into the lobby, and one from the lobby into the WC room.

A note in the top-left corner reads "See para 4.11". The left room is labelled "Food preparation area", with thin leader lines running from the text to two diagonal double-line elements drawn in the middle of the plan. The right room contains a water closet, drawn as an oval pan alongside a rectangular cistern set against the right-hand wall. At the top of the plan, set into the upper wall, is a hand washbasin shown as a rounded-rectangle basin containing an oval with a small circle at its centre. The two rooms are divided by a wall, with the washbasin positioned above that division and the WC to the right of it. The precise meaning of the two diagonal double-line elements is not clear from the drawing.
